verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated migration or import tool for bringing historical books over from another accounting system. The only path is indirect: the REST API claims full parity with the web client, so a founder could script a custom migration against the published OpenAPI spec. Bank statements can also be imported manually. A custom migration would be constrained by the documented 100 requests/minute and daily call caps. Missing for 10: a first-party migration or import tool from other accounting systems, import of historical journals, opening balances and transaction-level detail, and any hands-on or independent evidence that historical data migrates without loss.
